== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Dune Sea (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tatooine: Dune Sea]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-tatooine-dune-sea/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_TATOOINE_DUNE_SEA.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>92eaa9b9401f37620cdee949e79d7f2256dfada261d714f46786b2cc7c4b0747</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
